documents.title: Dyson Big Ball CY23 user manual (India)
documents.text_extraction_method: PDF text extraction only; no OCR

useful_identification_details.detail: The rating plate used to find the serial number is behind the clear bin.
The machine has a red on/off power button and a separate cable-retract control.

variant_limits: This manual is for CY23; do not treat it as proof of every Dyson Ball or Cinetic upright/cylinder variant.
Rating-plate text must be legible and attached to the physical machine to establish an exact identifier.

documents.title: Dyson V8 SV10 operating manual (US, English/Spanish)
documents.text_extraction_method: PDF text extraction only; no OCR

useful_identification_details.detail: The operating modes are labelled Powerful suction and Max mode.
The instructions refer to an ON trigger and a twist-removable filter B.

variant_limits: Official US V8/SV10 family manual; it does not establish the India Absolute accessory bundle.
The URL specifies without-soft-roller; absence or presence of a detachable cleaner head must not decide the family.
Several English pages have no extractable text; only cited text-bearing pages supplied these facts.

documents.title: Dyson V12 Detect Slim user manual (US)
documents.region_scope: US V12 Detect Slim family reference
documents.text_extraction_method: PDF text extraction only; no OCR

useful_identification_details.detail: The selection button is at the filter end of the machine and selects Eco, Auto/Med and Boost modes.
The LCD presents particle-count information, selected mode and remaining run time.
A red bin release slides the bin down and opens its base.
useful_identification_details.supporting_text: Firmly push the red bin release button.

variant_limits: This is a US family manual, not proof of the India Absolute colour or accessory package.
The document explicitly says not all pictured cleaner heads are included.
Generic trigger wording appears in maintenance descriptions; do not use that wording to establish the V12 power-control type.
Shared LCD and bin features do not alone distinguish V12 from V15.

documents.title: Dyson V15 Detect user manual (India-linked)
documents.text_extraction_method: PDF text extraction only; no OCR

useful_identification_details.detail: The manual lists a click-in battery and Laser Slim Fluffy or High Torque anti-tangle cleaner heads.
The LCD shows particle counts, selected cleaning mode and remaining run time.
The bin slides down when its red release is pushed, and the base opens.

variant_limits: The manual says the box contains one or more listed cleaner heads; not all are included.
Detachable accessories and these shared LCD features cannot alone establish an exact variant.
The cover contains SV12/JN placeholder text; do not use that placeholder as a V15 model identifier.

documents.title: Dyson V16 Piston Animal user manual (UK)
documents.text_extraction_method: PDF text extraction only; no OCR

useful_identification_details.detail: The wand has remote release and a built-in handheld tool; the listed main head is All Floor Cones Sense.
useful_identification_details.supporting_text: Wand with remote release and built-in-tool

useful_identification_details.detail: A red collar releases tools and a red button on the LCD starts the machine.
The dust-compression lever is separate from the bin-base release lever.

variant_limits: UK family manual; it includes optional Submarine 2.0 and Floor Dok accessories, which must not be assumed to be included with the India product.
This edition describes a silver bin release, while the US owner page describes a black release; use the mechanism rather than a universal colour rule.
The cover contains SV12/JN placeholder text; do not treat that as the V16 identifier.
